title: Favorite scent
text: Favorite scent. This is a great scent. Bought all I could find and found these here.

product_metadata.title: ScentSationals ''Rainy Day'' Wax Cubes by ScentSationals
description: ScentSationals offers a diverse assortment of long-lasting, highly fragrant wax cubes. Each package contains 6 wax cubes. Warm one or two to fill your home with your favorite scent. Scents are easy to change, allowing you to enjoy a variety of scents in your home or office.
